_what: How a person's posts are drafted, checked, approved and set to go at their time (read-data/posts.mjs). record_type is the kind of record a post is kept as; connection_type the kind of record a connection is kept as, whose id is connection_prefix + the connection id (encoded as a URL component). The link a post carries gets link_tags added, each a query parameter whose value is fixed (value) or taken from the post (from: post_id, platform or account_id); link_joiner goes between the words and the link. ready_limits are the limits a place's format may set on a file (read-data/post-ready.mjs), each the limit name in a media kind, the file fact it is compared with, whether the fact must stay at_most or at_least the limit, its unit and its plain name; ready_words are the plain words for each finding. first_contact: a post that names someone (names, a pattern whose first group is the handle) or lists them in reaches is approved only by the person on their own screen, never by a tool. words are every other plain answer. outcome_states turns each publisher outcome into the state a destination is in; resend_states are the states sent again by themselves (never one whose outcome is not known, which is resent only when the caller names it); outcome_words are the plain words for a failed destination, the first row matching its retry kind or a word in its code or message.

ready_words.not_connected: This account is no longer connected. Connect it again from Connections.
ready_words.needs_media: {platform} does not post words alone. Add a video or picture.
ready_words.media_gone: This post's video or picture is no longer in your files. Choose one that is.
ready_words.kind_not_taken: {platform} does not take this kind of file ({media_type}). It takes: {kinds}.
ready_words.takes_no_files: {platform} takes words only. Leave the video or picture out of the post for {platform}.
ready_words.type_not_taken: {platform} does not take this kind of {kind} file ({media_type}). It takes: {types}.
ready_words.too_many_characters: The words for {platform} are {count} characters; it takes at most {max}. Shorten the words for {platform}.
ready_words.setting_too_long: The {name} for {platform} is {count} characters; it takes at most {max}.
ready_words.not_known: Nobody gave the {kind}'s {fact_name}, so {platform}'s limit ({limit}) was not checked. Give media_facts to draft-a-post to have it checked.
ready_words.all_ready: Ready for every place it is going.
ready_words.connect_places: Pick where it goes: connect {platforms} in Connections, then choose it here.
ready_words.no_places: Pick where it goes: connect a place to post in Connections.
ready_words.file_not_checked: Whether the {kind} is still in the person's files was not checked here; check it is before the post goes.

words.person_only: This post reaches {names}. A first message to someone is approved only by the person, on their own screen, never by a tool.
words.reaches: reaches lists the people this post contacts first (at most {most}), each { network, handle, profile_url, provenance: [{ source, url, title, posted_at }] } with at least one place they were found.

outcome_words.says: {platform} needs you to sign in again. Ask your AI for the {platform} connect link, sign in, then publish again.
{platform} needs you to sign in again. Ask your AI for the {platform} connect link, sign in, then publish again.
{platform} is asking to slow down. Publish again later; the places that already have the post are not sent it again.
{platform} is asking to slow down. Publish again later; the places that already have the post are not sent it again.
The words are too long for {platform}. Shorten the caption for {platform} and publish again.

media._what: How a post's file reaches a place (read-data/send-a-post.mjs). A place that fetches the file from an address (media_from address) is handed a share of it from the person's files, valid share_seconds, which the place streams. A place that takes the bytes (media_from bytes) is streamed them from the person's files, read_bytes at a time. words are what is said when the file cannot be handed over: gone when the person's files no longer hold it, unreachable when their files could not answer.

words.gone: This post's video or picture is no longer in your files, so nothing was sent to {platform}. Choose one that is.
words.unreachable: Your files could not hand {platform} the post's file right now ({code}), so nothing was sent. Send it again shortly.

at_its_time._what: How a post set to go at its time is sent then (read-data/send-a-post.mjs sendEachPostAtItsTime). The person switches on the wake of tool:send-each-post-at-its-time; each time their posts change, it answers one timed run of the place's send row (post-places.json send_tool) per destination still to be sent, at the post's scheduled_for, told the post's armed_at. That run sends only while the post still carries that armed_at and is in sends_while, so a post taken back, changed or set again sends nothing at the old time. child_budget is what each timed send is given: the engine's run cost and its reserved run time (the engine's wake settings run_cost and its tool runs deadline_ms). most_sends is the most timed sends one firing answers (the engine's wake settings max_effects); the rest are named in left_out. words are its plain answers.

words.set: {count} sends are set to go at their time.
words.none: No changed post is set to go at its time, so nothing was set.
words.not_connected: This account is no longer connected, so this send was not set. Connect it again, then take the post back and set it to go again.
words.too_many: More sends were set at once than one firing takes ({most}), so this send was not set. Take the post back and set it to go again.
words.no_longer_set: This post is no longer set to go at that time, so nothing was sent.

markup._what: The markups a place may take a post's words in (read-data/publisher-requests.mjs inMarkup, named by a place row's {post: words, markup}). The words are read as Markdown into a post document (headings, paragraphs, lists, quotes, bold, italic, links); each node and mark is then wrapped in its row's opening and closing text ({level} is a heading's level, {href} a link's address), and each character in escape is written as its replacement. A node with no row is written as its contents. This is the wire format a place's API asks for, not anything shown on a screen.

not_known_words: It is not known whether {platform} took the post. Look on {platform}; if it is not there, send it to this account again with resend: true.
